A gravel loop on open grass with scattered trees beside a boat ramp and vault toilet; sites aren't marked out on imagery. Showers, dump and water fill are at Weigand-Burbach. --Claude
summary: Booking changed to first-come only: the SRA's ReserveAmerica loops are all at Weigand-Burbach. Pin ~390 m off (on the access road west of the area) - re-pin to the loop. Lakefront looks too high: the loop sits 40-80 m back on open grass behind the ramp's day-use lot and the loop road - downgrade to lakeview proposed. Phone 402-388-4169 (grid). Miller Creek campground (another SRA area, ~2 km WSW) is not in the DB.
flags: PIN ~390 m off, re-pin by hand: stored 42.83924,-97.64174 is on the access road where it bends along the shore, with no sites. The area's camping loop is ~42.8398,-97.6370 (gravel loop on grass with a vault toilet, just south of the boat ramp at ~42.8406,-97.6375).

WATERFRONT downgrade proposed (lakefront -> lakeview): on imagery the loop is set back 40-80 m from the shore; the ramp, its parking and the access spur sit between the loop's north side and the water, and the loop road itself runs along the lake side. Under the 2026-11-01 rulings the loop road and day use block an on-water value. The east side of the loop looks across 40-80 m of open grass with scattered trees to a sandy shore, so lakeview is plausible. The stored lakefront came from the 2026-06 sweep at this same wrong pin. SILTING: open water reaches this shore today (the delta silting is further west, upstream of Miller Creek); no mudflat between the area and the lake on imagery.

SPLIT/MISSING AREAS (no split proposed; each area already has its own entrance and place): the SRA has five areas along the south shore. In the DB: Bloomfield (2673), Burbach (2707, 42.83668,-97.59136) and Weigand (2750, 42.83497,-97.57071) - Bloomfield is ~3.7 km west of Burbach. MISSING: Miller Creek Campground (Google 42.83000,-97.66229, 4.4 from 12, 402-388-4169), ~2.0 km WSW of the Bloomfield loop, its own entrance road; imagery shows an open grass meadow with a ramp beside the Miller Creek inlet - a lead to vet under the curation doc (hookups, site count, sand/fit unknown). Also South Shore Area (42.84456,-97.48954, 4.6 from 9) near Gavins Point Dam, whose camping per Wikipedia is an equestrian campground - likely out of scope (horse camp) but unread. Deep Water is a wildlife area closed to camping per search snippets.
PHONE: none stored; the grid gives Lewis and Clark SRA 402-388-4169 (also on Google for each area). Suggest adding by hand.
SITES count 12 (derived) unverified; imagery shows an unmarked grass loop. Hookups at this area are unknown (the grid's classes are SRA-wide).

FEES left (provenance is a human read without method): $10-15 matches the grid's Basic $15 in season / $10 mid-Oct to April for an area without hookups; if the area has electric the high would be higher.
SAND RULE passes: gravel loop on grass; the sandy strip is the shoreline, not a parking area.
WEBSITE: the RA line points to the SRA's bookable loops, none of which are this area; consider dropping it (by hand) now that the area is first-come only.
